name: vipul-ai-hub
description: Vipul's Project Hub — launch all 5 projects from one command

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "HUB,DISCUSS,NOVA,SHADOW,SKILL,ROOMMATE" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta,green,red,yellow,blue" "npm run hub" "npm run start:discusshub" "npm run start:nova-store" "npm run start:shadow-case" "npm run start:skillhub" "npm run start:roommate-finder"
